title: Which card became urgent?
hook: A named task changes priority after it enters the queue.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Heap parent/child ordering and priority comparisons.
doesNotKnow: Use an item-to-position index to locate a decreased key before bubbling it upward.

misconception: Changing a priority requires searching the whole heap or inserting a duplicate.
objective: Use an item-to-position index to locate a decreased key before bubbling it upward.

claims.text: The position map finds the named task directly. Every upward swap repairs both map entries, so later decreases still address the right item rather than an obsolete array position.
